tagline: A clear view of your gateway.
overviewDesc: Usage, balances, and the health of your gateway.
tokensDesc: Create and manage keys for your applications.
channelsDesc: Connect your providers and keep traffic flowing.
usersDesc: Account access and carefully controlled balances.
logsDesc: Every recorded charge, with shortfalls kept separate.
auditDesc: A record of management changes and their actors.
redemptionsDesc: Issue prepaid quota codes and track redemption.
optionsDesc: Pricing and operational controls, one change at a time.
profileDesc: Your account, usage, and prepaid quota.
loginDesc: Welcome back. Your gateway is ready.
registerDesc: One account to connect all your applications.
usernameRule: Use 3–64 letters, digits, underscores, dots or hyphens.
noDataDesc: Records will appear here when you start using this feature.
noResultsDesc: Try another filter or clear your search.
name: Name
tokenHelp: A token limit is not a top-up. Unlimited tokens still use the account balance.
secretHelp: This is the only time the full key is displayed. Copy it before closing.
copyFailed: Clipboard unavailable. Select and copy the text manually.
keyReplace: Leave empty to keep the existing key. A new key resets per-key health states.
keysHelp: One key per line. Bedrock: accessKeyId|secretAccessKey|region.
expirationHelp: Leave empty for no expiration. Times use your local timezone.
balanceConfirm: I confirm setting the current balance to this amount.
balanceHint: A concurrent balance change will reject this save. Reload and confirm again.
conflict: Balance changed. Close this form, refresh, and confirm the new balance.
pendingUncertain: The request may have completed. Refresh the list before submitting again.
probeHelp: Sends a real upstream request and may change channel status.
runtimeHelp: Process-local counters reset on restart. Channels use the latest {window} upstream attempts.
ttftHelp: TTFT may fall back to response-header latency for non-streaming or incomplete streams.
stale: Refresh failed. Showing the last successful data.
redeemHelp: Enter a prepaid code to add quota to your account.
inviteHelp: Share your invite link. Registration rewards follow the administrator’s settings.
zeroHelp: Redeem a prepaid code or contact your administrator before making API requests.
optionHelp: Each setting saves independently. Expressions take precedence over per-call prices, then token ratios.
defaultsHelp: Model and completion maps merge built-in defaults. Removing a built-in entry restores its default; it does not disable billing.
discardHelp: Your changes have not been saved.
forbiddenHelp: Your account does not have access to this page.
notFoundHelp: This page may have moved, or the address is incorrect.
invalidNumber: Enter a valid non-negative whole number
invalidJson: Enter a valid JSON value with the required types and bounds
collectionNote: Collected and unfunded costs are separate. Unfunded cost is not an automatic debt claim.
localTime: Times shown in your local timezone
